responsibility: Provides the GIMPLE-level semantic comparison engine used by IPA identical code folding. The func_checker implementation compares SSA names, CFG edges, declarations, types, labels, returns, switches, gotos, asm blocks, loads/stores, and other statement operands between two functions while maintaining source-to-target mapping tables. This file is the low-level equivalence checker that ipa-icf.cc relies on to prove two functions semantically identical.
same_name_distinction: Implements the statement- and operand-level GIMPLE equivalence checks used by ICF, such as SSA, CFG edge, decl, label, switch, return, goto, and asm comparison. Unlike gcc/ipa-icf-gimple.h, it provides the concrete comparison logic rather than the checker class declarations and logging macros.
